Membership Management

﻿Playspots has transformed how people find and book sports venues. Now, we’re taking things a step further by making it easier than ever to connect with and manage Sports Academies.

Playspots Membership Management will be a game-changer.Venue will gain access to a wider audience of potential students and players, streamline administrative tasks, and improve communication with players

Explore the features
Manage Members & Membership Plans

Easily manage members, create flexible membership plans, assign schedules, and organize batches—all from one dashboard.

Add and manage unlimited members
Create flexible plans, durations, and pricing
Organize batches and training schedules easily
Lead Management

Capture, organize, and manage all your membership inquiries and potential leads in one centralized dashboard—so you never miss a conversion opportunity.

Track and manage new membership inquiries efficiently
Assign leads to staff and follow up instantly
Convert prospects into active members faster
Attendance Tracking

Monitor member attendance effortlessly with real-time tracking tools that help you manage batches, sessions, and participation accurately.

Mark and track daily member attendance easily
Monitor batch participation and attendance history
Generate attendance insights and performance reports
Coaches Login

Provide dedicated coach access to manage schedules, mark attendance, monitor members, and stay connected—all through a secure login portal.

Secure login access for coaches and staff
Manage schedules, sessions, and attendance
Track player progress and communicate updates easily
Payment Collections

Collect membership fees effortlessly through payment links, QR codes, and digital payment requests. Simplify collections while giving members a convenient and secure payment experience.

Generate instant payment links and QR codes
Share payment requests directly via WhatsApp or SMS
Track collections and payment status in real time
Reports & Business Insights

Track revenue, memberships, payments, and performance with real-time dashboards and actionable analytics.

Monitor revenue and payment performance
Track member growth and attendance trends
Make better decisions with real-time reports
Ready to simplify academy operations?

Join thousands of academies using Playspots to save time, improve communication and grow their business.
